code.INTAKE_NO_TEXT: No text could be read from this document. Upload a clearer photo or a PDF, or enter the bill by hand.

code.INTAKE_APPROVAL_INTERRUPTED: Approving this document was interrupted before a draft was created. Review it and approve it again.

reviewReason.LOW_CONFIDENCE: The document was hard to read. Compare every value with the original.
reviewReason.NOT_A_BILL: This may not be a bill or receipt.
reviewReason.VENDOR_MISSING: No existing vendor matched. Choose or add the vendor.

reviewReason.CURRENCY_MISSING: The currency was not found. Choose the currency before creating the bill.
reviewReason.LINES_MISSING: No lines were read. Enter the bill lines.
reviewReason.VALUES_INCONSISTENT: Some values on the document do not add up. Check the totals and tax.
reviewReason.DUE_DATE_DERIVED: The due date is not on the document; it was set to the bill date plus 30 days. Check it.
reviewReason.POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE: This may be a bill you already entered.

intake.existingDraft: This document was already approved. Its draft already exists.
intake.discrepancyTitle: Extracted totals do not match the computed totals

intake.streamUnavailable: This scan is no longer available. Please upload the document again.
